description: highly detailed crisp pixel art scene, fine pixel detail: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands, seen from the side facing right, standing in a small field and hoeing a bed of dark soil with an iron hoe, rows of young green sprouts and a low wooden fence behind, an old scarecrow in the distance, soft morning light, the whole figure and the bed inside the frame
